description:
KEY FEATURES

The designs are permanently pressed directly onto the decoration, creating, an everlasting image that will NOT peel off or fade. This product can not  be customized shape.

Writing Surface: The clip board serves as a convenient and portable writing surface, providing stability while taking notes or completing forms.

Document Organization: It helps in keeping various documents, papers, or forms organized and secure, preventing them from getting lost or damaged.

Outdoor Use: In outdoor settings, clip boards offer a stable surface for writing, even in environments where tables or desks might not be available.

Customization: Clip boards can be personalized with branding, logos, or colors, making them suitable for promotional purposes or as corporate gifts.

 Home and Office: At home or in the office, clip boards can hold to-do lists, reminders, or important documents, keeping you organized.

The multi-functionality of the clipboard makes it an essential tool in various professional, educational, and personal contexts.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups Clipboard and Penbox

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
